# Candidate Assessment: DOC_resume_ninety vs. DOC_posting_ten_five

## Mandatory Requirements

| # | Requirement | Resume | Match |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Python | Languages | ✅ |
| 2 | SQL | Languages | ✅ |
| 3 | Linux administration | Platform | ✅ |
| 4 | Git | Platform | ✅ |
| 5 | REST API design | Services | ✅ |
| 6 | Unit testing | Services | ✅ |
| 7 | CI pipelines | Services | ✅ |
| 8 | Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Helm | Infrastructure (all five) | ✅ |
| 9 | Kafka | Streaming | ✅ |
| 10 | GraphQL | Not listed | ❌ |

**Mandatory match: 9 of 10 = 90%**

Item 8 bundles five tools. If you count each tool separately, there are 14 requirements and the candidate meets 13, or **92.9%**. The candidate has all five tools, so either way of counting gives a result above the threshold.

## Nice-to-Have (no effect on outcome)

None of the five items (Grafana, Prometheus, technical writing, mentoring, public speaking) appear on the resume. As instructed, this does not affect the decision.

## Decision

**Proceed.** The 90% mandatory match is above the 85% threshold.

**Gap to note:** GraphQL is the only missing mandatory skill. It is worth checking in interview, since the candidate's REST API background may transfer.
